name: jarvis-physical-bridge
description: USB-serial -> HTTP bridge: reads command IDs from the Arduino + DF2301Q, POSTs to Jarvis web app's /api/jarvis/physical/trigger.

scripts.list-ports: node -e "import('serialport').then(({SerialPort}) => SerialPort.list().then(ps => ps.forEach(p => console.log(p.path, p.manufacturer ?? '', p.serialNumber ?? ''))))"
